Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used a hybrid approach: DDA for library generation and PRM for targeted quantification of specific proteins (CD81, claudin-1, etc.) extracted from gel bands. While DDA was used, the primary quantification goal was targeted (PRM). No specific PTM enrichment was performed; the 'Oxidation' identified in PRIDE metadata is a common variable modification.

scope: Peptides obtained from selected proteins (CD81, claudin-1, occludin, SR-BI, occluding, SCD) using in-gel trypsin digestion (tryptic digestion kit, Thermo) were detected and quantified using Liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) methods.

A total of 11 gel bands were analysed by LC-MS (Gel image), confirming the presence of proteins (O00767)ACOD, (P60033)CD81, (Q8WTV0)SCRB1, (O95832)CLD1, (Q16625)OCLN. Peptides from gel bands corresponding to each of these proteins were quantified using the LC-MS PRM based method to evaluate the effect of drug treatment.

This constitutes a purified protein scope rather than whole cell lysate.
